title: Edgeware: The Grassroots Relay (and spawner of community backed parachains) Network Plan proposal
body:
# Edgeware: The Grassroots Relay 


_Tagline: Edgeware can be the third relay chain, which has a special role, to fund, spawn and support new parachains in the Substrate ecosystem._

After the light and useful discussion we had with Shankar and Thom last week (of May) in the developer meeting, and discussing with filip today, here’s a summary network plan for Edgeware which can be achieved in 6 to 12 months: 

_<this proposal is draft and still being updated>_

## Edgeware Relay Chain with EdgeEVM parachain. 

Edgeware Relay is much more potent in the long term as a multichain framework that has evm capability through its first parachain, than just a smart contract solo chain. 

## Plan

We break down the most challenging upgrade in substrate (erup5), into 3 pieces: 

1. **Edgeware Core Upgrade** - “Edgeware-v0.9.18 OR Erup5" - upgrade of the core system pallets we use day to day; primitives, types and storage migrations.  

2. **Relay Flip** - “relayflip-v0.9.18” - add relay functionality; crowdloan switched off, and all parachains installed through governance (details to follow). 

3. **EdgeEVM parachain** - “paraevm-v0.9.19” - the first of Edgeware’s parachains, EdgeEVM. (details to follow). 

## FAQ:

**Edgeware has too low market cap to be a relay and secure parachains.** If we were running outside projects parachains then this would be a concern. However adding relay and running our own parachain(s) makes no difference to Edgeware’s security. 

**will that mean EdgeEVM has its own cryptocurrency?** Not necessarily, EdgeEVM would use EDG. 

**What about become a parachain on Polkadot?** we can still do this, but the EdgewareRelay can stay a relay and preserve its historical blocks.
